Jordan Park: Morning sync notes  we need to finalize R3 slice for Optimize toolkit. Customers want measurable wins: batching, cache hints, quant guidance, eval-triggered alerts. Cant do all heavy runtime work this quarter.
Leah Morrison: Agreed. My suggested triage: 1) safe runtime heuristics (batching) with rollback, 2) advisory outputs (quant + cache hints), 3) read-only eval alerts.
Evan Cho: For batching, propose three conservative modes: \u2018sticky-prefix\u2019, \u2018micro-batch\u2019, and \u2018pacing-limiter\u2019. Each must have instant feature-flag rollback and per-route SLO checks.
Sofia Alvarez: Compliance/customer asks: exportable audit trail + a one-line rationale for each rec. We can synthesize rationale from rule metadata: "Why: est -%tokens; Risk: possible p99 uplift". Good enough for pilots.
Leah Morrison: Acceptance criteria draft: - onboard 3 pilots, - Console shows per-route token delta + p50/p95/p99 deltas, - p99 regression <= 10% for enrolled routes, - recommendation adoption tracked (goal >=25%), - eval-alert FP <= 7% in pilot.
Evan Cho: Telemetry events: opt.r3.rule_eval, opt.r3.rule_applied, opt.r3.recommendation_viewed, opt.r3.alert_fired. Need sample size calc for alert precision.
Jordan Park: Owners: runtime = Evan, telemetry = Leah, Console = Sofia. Timeline: W1 spec + rule schema, W2 runtime prototype + perf baseline, W3 telemetry + Console stub, W4 pilot rollout + metrics review.
Sofia Alvarez: Quick UX note: advisory cards should show: preset, expected savings, confidence, short rationale, and CSV export button.
ops-bot: Poll posted "R3 priority" options: [Batching, Advisory recs, Eval-alerts] Vote: https://redwood.internal/poll/11321
Leah Morrison: Vote: Batching > Advisory > Alerts.
Jordan Park: Final decision for R3: prioritize safe batching heuristics (opt-in w/ recommended default) + advisor-only quant/cache recs + read-only eval alerts. Feature flags per-customer and per-route.
Evan Cho: Blocker: kernel-level batching optimization may be deprioritized; I'll build user-space scheduler fallback to unblock pilot. Perf-run request incoming.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll sketch the Console tiles and export UX by EOD and link the mock doc: <https://redwood.internal/docs/optimize/r3-pilot-mock|R3 pilot mock>.
Jordan Park: If no objections by EOD, lock R3 scope and publish spec. :thumbsup:
